# Plugin.Maui.LocalStore

Room-style app-document facade for .NET MAUI. One collection API; the host picks SQLite or NuvexaDB. Switching backends does not migrate data.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.LocalStore
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.LocalStore
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-local-store/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.LocalStore

Registration: `UseMauiLocalStore` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- Room-style local database in .NET MAUI
- Switch between SQLite and NuvexaDB with one DAO
- IStoreCollection / StoreFilter for app documents

## Do not use when

- You need durable jobs — that is Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
- You need offline sync — that is Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
- You only want Nuvexa — use Nuventra.NuvexaDB directly
